statement: Securities sold under Rule 506 are federally covered securities, so state registration and qualification requirements are preempted (15 U.S.C. § 77r(a)(1), (b)(4)(F)), but states may still require notice filings of documents filed with the SEC and assess filing fees (15 U.S.C. § 77r(c)(2)(A)).
caveat: Most states require a Form D notice filing and fee, each with its own deadline; antifraud authority is never preempted. This repo does not enumerate per-state blue-sky filing deadlines.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (law-map 2026-10-14); independent domain expert review pending
